svg.aria-label: A wiring bench for a push notification. A phone on a cradle at the front left sends a signal through two knife switches, permission and push token, and a third, POST /register-device, into a token drawer on the backend. A worker box at the back left finishes a job and, through a fourth switch, device_id, tells the backend whom to notify. The backend posts to Expo's push service: a meter on it reads HTTP 200 and a receipt slip prints the response body. Expo hands the message to Apple's or Google's service, and a long wire round the front carries it back to the phone, where a banner appears. Open any switch and the signal stops there without an error: the job still shows finished, and with an old token on file the meter still reads 200; only the slip says DeviceNotRegistered.
